title: NBN POI 3MTE (Mt Eliza) NNI Rehoming
current_summary: We will perform planned maintenance on our NBN interconnect at Mt Eliza (POI 3MTE) in Melbourne. The window is Friday 7 August, 12:00 AM to 3:00 AM AEST. NBN services connected to this POI may experience disruptions of up to 2 hours in total during the window while we move services to a new router at Exhibition Exchange. No action is required. We will monitor closely and restore services as soon as the work is complete.

updates.content: We are scheduling maintenance on our NBN interconnect at Mt Eliza (POI 3MTE) in Melbourne to move services to a new router at Exhibition Exchange. This work will take place on Friday 7 August, between 12:00 AM and 3:00 AM AEST. During this window, customers with NBN services connected to the Mt Eliza POI may experience one or more brief interruptions, up to a total of 2 hours. No action is needed from you. Our team will monitor the change and work to minimise any disruption.
